title: Senior AI & Automation Engineer
description:
Senior AI & Automation Engineer - £70,000 - Hybrid

Location: Newcastle, Nottingham, Bromsgrove or Hungerford
Salary: £70,000 per annum
Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days office / 2 days home
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

An established international software organisation is looking for a Senior AI & Automation Engineer to join its growing Cloud Operations function, helping to drive infrastructure automation, cloud transformation and the adoption of AI-powered technologies.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced DevOps, Platform or Cloud Automation Engineer who enjoys remaining hands-on while influencing technical direction, introducing new technologies and improving engineering practices.

You'll play a key role in designing and delivering scalable automation solutions across a complex cloud environment, with a particular focus on Terraform, Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and AI-driven automation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and implement infrastructure automation solutions across cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions, primarily using Terraform.
  • Support cloud migration and modernisation initiatives, automating provisioning, configuration and deployment processes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes and improve operational efficiency through automation.
  • Design, develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines.
  • Explore and implement AI-powered automation, including LLM-assisted tooling and AI agents.
  • Develop reusable automation frameworks, engineering standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Cloud Operations, DevOps and infrastructure teams to introduce more efficient ways of working.
  • Embed security, identity management and secrets management into automation solutions.
  • Mentor engineers, share technical knowledge and help drive an automation-first engineering culture.

Skills & Experience Required

  • Strong hands-on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering or Infrastructure Automation.
  • Advanced experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience scripting and developing automation using Python, PowerShell or Bash.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience automating cloud infrastructure provisioning, deployments or migrations.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools, LLMs or AI automation technologies.
  • Understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, and secrets management.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to design and implement technical solutions independently.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and promoting engineering best practices.

Desirable Experience

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Pulumi or Bicep.
  • AI agents, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or other AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Cloud migration and infrastructure transformation projects.
  • Disaster recovery, resilience and cloud cost optimisation.
  • Experience developing reusable automation frameworks across multiple teams.

What's on Offer?

  • £70,000 salary
  • Hybrid working - 3 days office / 2 days home.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to influence automation and AI engineering practices.
  • Exposure to modern cloud technologies and AI-powered tooling.
  • Significant technical ownership within a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and technical leadership.
  • Compensated on-call rota where applicable.

Terraform, Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Cloud Automation, DevOps, AI Agents,
